observations.observer: current user, native Yoruba listener (voice session)
observations.scope: This p03 pilot: one natural reference, two mini-TTS takes, two Realtime takes; not a general model-level finding
observations.observation: The AI-generated recordings were cut more cleanly and were easier to accept as usable. Cuts in the natural human reference more often seemed to extend into neighboring material, sometimes perceived as a breath-like transition, and required more adjustment.
observations.subject: word-cut / segmentation usability only
observations.causal_explanation: Not established. Coarticulation, word spacing, alignment behavior and playback margins are possible explanations, not findings.
limitations: Earlier natural cuts included unsuccessful visual estimates, then speech-model proposals and revisions.
Review history and adjustment methods were not identical across conditions; this is not a controlled alignment benchmark.
Breath-like quality is a perceptual description, not an acoustically verified diagnosis.
